# SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a recorded capture from the user's RYBOZEN V316B.
# Authored 2026-10-19 from the documented format set of the Macrosilicon
# MS2130 USB 3 capture class (uvcvideo, YUYV 4:2:2 to 1920x1080@60; MJPG at
# 1080p30 on the class's recording path). Shape is stock v4l2-ctl
# --list-formats-ext output (v4l-utils 1.3x) so it parses through
# devices.ParseFormatsExt unchanged. The first real device enumeration on
# the UNO Q supersedes this fixture (docs/spec/10: never assume the modes).
ioctl: VIDIOC_ENUM_FMT
	Type: Video Capture

	[0]: 'YUYV' (YUYV 4:2:2)
		Size: Discrete 640x480
			Interval: Discrete 0.033s (30.000 fps)
		Size: Discrete 1280x720
			Interval: Stepwise 0.017s - 0.033s [30.000 - 60.000 fps]
		Size: Discrete 1920x1080
			Interval: Stepwise 0.017s - 0.033s [30.000 - 60.000 fps]
	[1]: 'MJPG' (Motion-JPEG, compressed)
		Size: Discrete 1280x720
			Interval: Stepwise 0.033s - 0.067s [15.000 - 30.000 fps]
		Size: Discrete 1920x1080
			Interval: Stepwise 0.033s - 0.500s [2.000 - 30.000 fps]
